text:
alex: heads up — want to start a sequenced activation for gannet-7b-q4 (int4) next week. needs hosted + dedicated + private playbooks. who can own the plan?

mira: I can drive the hosted canary. propose 2-hour canary with 5% traffic -> 20% -> 50% over 3 steps. smoke + regression evals at each step. :rocket:

devon: I'll take dedicated capacity coordination (autoscale limits, fallback tokens). need GPU quota check with infra.

sanjay: private deployment (customer VPC) checklist depends on KMS rollout window. ETA on customer onboarding for staged test?

eva: quick note on quality: our eval harness showed a 0.7% drop on the summaries test set vs current baseline at int4. we need per-prompt failure review before moving past 20%. put a hold trigger if delta > 0.5% on P95 regression.

alex: good call. propose the following rollback/hold triggers:
- latency P95 increases > 30% vs baseline
- quality regressions P95 > 0.5% on critical eval sets
- error rate > 0.2% or 5xx spikes for 5m

mira: agree. also add per-route unit-cost threshold: if tokens/sec cost > 1.2x planned, revert to int8 variant.

deploy-bot: deployment plan generated: gannet-7b-q4 -> hosted canary -> dedicated canary -> private smoke -> full roll. details: https://internal.redwood/deploys/1839991234 :white_check_mark:

devon: infra check: dedicated pool sizing = 8xA100 for steady 200 RPS. autoscale min 2, max 12. burst policy allowed to 16 for 10m.

sanjay: private note: customer sandbox needs IP allowlist, test keys and HSM staging. recommend windows: Tue 04:00-06:00 UTC for initial sandbox to avoid business hours.

eva: adding eval steps:
1) perf smoke (latency, memory) - 15m
2) regression suite (1000 prompts) - run with gold answers, diff 
3) human spot-check (10 prompts) - UX + hallucination focus

alex: traffic split JSON for hosted canary (simple):
```json
{
  "step_1": {"duration_min": 120, "traffic_percent": 5, "fallback": "gannet-7b-int8"},
  "step_2": {"duration_min": 180, "traffic_percent": 20, "fallback": "gannet-7b-int8"},
  "step_3": {"duration_min": 240, "traffic_percent": 50, "fallback": "heron-3b-int8"}
}
```

mira: looks good. add health-check endpoint: `/v1/health?canary=true` returns model_version + kv_cache_hit_rate + seq_latencies.

devon: ops/playbook reminders:
- preflight: model artifacts checksum, tokenizer version, kv cache warmup script
- canary: dedicated logs -> elk index `gannet-canary-183999`
- rollback: automatic alias switch script `alias_switch.sh`

eva: QA gating: block progression if any of these are true: 
- eval delta > 0.5%
- user-facing hallucination instances >= 3/1000 prompts in human spot-check
- new safety classifier false positive rate > 1%

sanjay: for private customers, we should run the canary on a snapshot of their traffic (5% mirrored) and run privacy checks. note: mirror might require extra bandwidth; notify customer AP teams.

alex: timeline suggestion:
- Mon: infra preflight + smoke on staging
- Tue-AM: hosted step_1 (5% 2h) 
- Tue-PM: hosted step_2 (20% 3h) if green
- Wed: hosted step_3 (50% 4h) then dedicated warmup
- Thu: private sandbox + customer mirror tests

mira: monitoring hooks to add: per-route SLO dashboard, per-token cost chart, ephemerally store sample outputs for 48h with tag `gannet-7b-q4-canary` for regression debugging.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary start: 1840000400 UTC (automated). will post status updates.

oncall-bot: alert policy attached: `gannet_canary_policy` -> pages on SRE if latency P95 > threshold for 15m.

devon: I pushed `alias_switch.sh` to infra repo. snippet: `./alias_switch.sh --from=gannet-stable --to=gannet-7b-q4 --dry-run`

eva: reminder: run the eval harness with seed 42 and save outputs to `s3://redwood-evals/gannet-q4/canary-run-183999`

alex: final asks before go: 
- mira: confirm hosted canary runbook and who will be oncall during the 2h window
- devon: confirm dedicated pool ops and rollback script access
- sanjay: confirm private customer windows and KMS keys ready
- eva: confirm eval pass and sampling plan

mira: I'll be oncall Tue 09:00-13:00 UTC. eva will triage quality alerts with me.

devon: infra green. rollback script access granted to `infra-ops` and `eng-ml` groups.

sanjay: KMS keys provisioned for sandbox. customer notified for Tue window.

eva: starting eval run now, will post results in this thread.

alex: thanks all — keep this thread as the single source of truth for decisions. ping me if any blocker. :eyes:
